en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Al Magra’a, from Abdullah Bin Suleyman who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The doing of an act of kindness repels the evil encounters’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from ibn abu al-Mighra’ from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sulayman who has said the following: “
I heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘Providing Benevolent Assistance repels wicked encounters.’”
